title: Worn ring, 1st and 3rd person
desc: The ring worn on the right hand all the time, idle, charge pulse and equip power-up, each in first and third person; J: "the ring should stay on when wearing it".

takes.name: idle, steady glow
takes.facts: steady glow with a small shimmer (emission 5 +/- 0.4), arms sway; loops every 80 ticks

takes.name: charge pulse up the arm
takes.facts: ring rises to 9, a band of light runs hand > elbow > shoulder > chest and the eyes light; ticks 13-30, twice per 80

takes.name: equip power-up
takes.facts: ring forms on the finger pixel by pixel (10-22), flashes to 14 at 22, a light ring rushes out, fist up, body outline flashes 25-33
